Job responsibilities Lead end-to-end technical design of EIM solutions aligned with enterprise standards and security policies Define and standardize architecture patterns, best practices, and reusable frameworks Conduct design reviews and provide technical governance for scalable, high-quality implementations Translate security and business requirements into actionable technical solutions Architect, build, test, and deploy Sail Point-based IAM solutions from the ground up Deliver resilient identity solutions across complex, distributed environments Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth implementation and production rollout Own delivery lifecycle end-to-end, including planning, estimation, timelines, and risk management Act as Tier 3 escalation point, leading root cause analysis and long-term fixes Drive innovation through Po Cs and adoption of modern EIM Integrations (APIs, cloud integrations) Qualifications and Core Expertise Minimum of 8 years of hands-on experience in Identity Management within large-scale, global environments. 3+ years experience working in a multinational work environment (Healthcare Industry experience a plus) as an Engineer/Technical team member Strong customer engagement and presentation skills with the ability to communicate across all levels (senior and/or small audiences) Deep technical expertise in Sail Point Identity IQ, specifically in design, custom development, troubleshooting, and architecture. Familiarity with CI/CD, Dev Ops, and modern architecture (APIs, microservices, cloud) Strong understanding of RBAC, Segregation of Duties (So D), and access governance frameworks. title: Product Owner - Digital Process Automation (DPA)
jobDescription:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Product Owner
- Digital Process Automation (DPA) The Workflow Automation team is dedicated to streamlining Roche’s global operations through intelligent automation and Citizen Development. We focus on creating seamless, integrated digital journeys that reduce manual effort and improve compliance. As part of this team, you will influence the technical direction of the DPA ecosystem, ensuring our platforms provide maximum value to stakeholders across the organization. As the Product Owner (PO) for Digital Process Automation, you will be a techno-functional leader within the Workflow Automation team at Roche. In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex business requirements and technical execution, serving as the primary visionary for our DPA platform. You will take ownership of the product roadmap, navigating ambiguous business needs to deliver high-impact automation solutions. Leveraging your expertise in Pega or similar platforms, you will lead agile squads to build scalable, secure, and efficient workflows that transform Roche’s digital landscape. The Opportunity Drive Product Vision: Take full ownership of the DPA product backlog, translating high-level business strategies into well-defined user stories and technical requirements. Orchestrate Agile Squads: Lead cross-functional agile teams as a techno-functional leader, prioritizing the backlog based on business value, technical debt, and architectural sustainability. Execute Strategic Initiatives: Drive medium-to-large (M/L) automation initiatives from conception through deployment, ensuring alignment with Roche’s global strategic goals. Master Stakeholder Alignment: Act as the primary point of contact for business partners, skillfully navigating complex group dynamics to align diverse stakeholders on a unified vision. Shape Techno-Functional Strategy: Align the DPA roadmap with global IT strategy, conducting feasibility studies for complex process automations and evaluating emerging technologies. Champion Engineering Excellence: Ensure the platform adheres to strict security standards and compliance protocols, driving continuous improvements in Dev Ops and CI/CD for DPA. Mentor and Lead: Act as a bridge between business and IT, mentoring junior POs and engineers while actively participating in internal technology communities and tech talks. Optimize Digital Journeys: Influence the technical direction of the DPA ecosystem to create seamless integrated workflows that reduce manual effort and maximize organizational value. Who you are Proven Product Leader: You bring 3–5 years of experience leading product teams as a Product Owner within an Agile environment, specifically delivering complex software products. DPA Domain Expert: You possess extensive experience in designing and implementing Digital Process Automation (DPA) or Business Process Management (BPM) solutions. Platform Specialist: You have significant expertise in the Pega Platform (preferred) or similar DPA/Low-Code technologies such as Appian, Camunda, or Flow. Integration Savvy: You have a strong understanding of modern integration patterns (APIs, Microservices) and how DPA platforms interact within a global enterprise ecosystem. Educated & Qualified: You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience). Agile Expert: You possess an expert-level command of Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and are proficient in tools like Jira for sophisticated backlog management. Strategic Communicator: You are a "bigger picture" thinker with excellent negotiation skills, capable of managing demanding stakeholders and challenging the status quo to drive outcomes. title: Platform Architect - Servicenow
jobDescription: At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Introduction The Principal Platform Architect focuses on ensuring the security, compliance, stability, and integrity of the Service Now platform (ITSx, HRSD, CSM, etc.) and its connected ecosystem. In this highly strategic role, you will guide others in resolving complex security and risk-related issues, define and manage overarching Service Now Security Architecture, technical compliance, and Platform Health & Resiliency. As a recognized leader in architecture practices, you will develop a Security and Governance Roadmap, oversee the technical control framework, and drive the adoption of best-in-class security standards across the enterprise. The Opportunity In this role, you will be at the forefront of securing our enterprise digital backbone. You will: Establish and govern security and compliance requirements (NFRs) for all platform applications and integrations to ensure global alignment. Architect and audit the platform's security posture throughout the entire product life cycle, adhering strictly to internal policies and external standards like GDPR, HIPAA, and Gx P. Drive Security Reference Architectures and Hardening Patterns, systematically recording and publishing critical Architecture Risk Decisions (ARDs). Design and implement robust data loss prevention (DLP) and disaster recovery/business continuity capabilities to ensure zero-disruption platform resiliency. Lead technical governance by defining standards and evaluating new demands against platform capabilities and industry best practices. Influence senior stakeholders by communicating complex technical strategies and partnering closely to align platform security with evolving business needs. Optimize platform health by guiding design considerations for performance, integration, and remediation of configurations to maintain a "clean-core" environment. Mentor and develop architectural talent across the organization, serving as a recognized leader in secure coding and architecture practices. Who you are You are a strategic thinker with a deep technical mastery of the Service Now ecosystem and a passion for security excellence. Experienced Professional: You bring a proven track record of leading major, end-to-end Service Now implementations across multiple domains like ITSM, HRSD, and CSM. Educated Expert: You hold a University degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field, providing a strong theoretical foundation for complex architecture. Strategic Architect: You have extensive experience designing business-driven, future-ready solutions within a multiple-solution or product-line context. Security Specialist: You possess in-depth, expert-level knowledge of Service Now Access Control, Data Protection, High-Availability (HA), and Disaster Recovery (DR). Technical Master: You are proficient in designing security controls for the CMDB and managing complex integration pathways via Integration Hub and MID Servers. Influential Leader: You have exceptional communication skills, with the ability to influence senior-level stakeholders and mentor talent in architecture practices. Certified Professional: You are ideally a Service Now Certified Master Architect (CMA) or Certified Technical Architect (CTA), with a proactive mindset for adopting new technology trends. #RDT2026 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate.
